conviction_note: Four of six months were pre-released at the 19 Aug AGM (revenue +9.8%, volumes +5.6%, margins stable, profit in line), so the new lines are Aug-Sep, the H2 current-trading tone and the interim dividend; the only counterparty data since then (Travis Perkins merchanting LFL volume -9.0% in Jul-Sep, inflation levelling) cuts against a confident outlook while Howdens is positive, so p_up sits near 50 (48) on an abs move of 5% sized for a thin ($156k/day), one-broker name whose own results days have moved -9.3%, +4.4% and +8.3%; findings sum -1.0 and the scaled number -0.2 agree in sign and are both small because the evidence is balanced.

findings.finding: The AGM update pre-released four of the six months at revenue +9.8%, volumes +5.6% and margins at H2 FY26 levels, which implies H1 operating profit up on last year's flat GBP11.1m; the company already called net profit 'in line', so the remaining surprise is small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 half-year with profit slipping moved +4.39%; Nov 2024 half-year -9.3%; the stock rose on the Aug 2026 AGM update (AJ Bell headline).
findings.original_quote: Margins remain consistent with the second half of the prior financial year. Overheads remain well controlled and net profit is in line with market expectations.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced: the stock reacted on 19 Aug and the company tied profit to expectations. What is unpriced is only Aug-Sep, which would show as a move above the ~1,065p August level if the market expected a beat; spot is 1,057p, flat.

findings.finding: Travis Perkins, a builders-merchant counterparty segment Latham sells into, reported Q3 (Jul-Sep 2026) merchanting like-for-like volume -9.0% (YTD -5.6%), worse than H1, with price/mix +6.8% and weakness concentrated in new-build residential, covering the two H1 months Latham has not disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Latham's Nov 2024 half-year (-9.3%) came amid weak merchant volumes and cost-price deflation; no clean read on this specific peer line.
findings.original_quote: Q3 2026 Merchanting ... Like-for-like volume (9.0)% ... UK construction output and volumes remain subdued, most notably in new build residential
findings.why_not_priced: Peer data, not Latham's: a market that had transmitted it would have marked LTHM down after 15 Oct; the 20-day run-up is +2.1% and 60-day -1.2%, flat. Latham has been taking share (a competitor's administration, LDT pack timber), so transmission is uncertain, which is why it is small.
findings.independence: TDUK H1 2026 imports -3.9% on falling housing starts: https://www.buildersmerchantsnews.co.uk/news/trade-bodies/uk-timber-imports-remain-subdued-h1-2026

findings.finding: Howden Joinery reported UK sales +6.8% for 14 Jun-31 Oct 2026 with record TradeFest peak trading and outlook unchanged, a positive read for the kitchen/joinery trade that consumes the panels and decorative surfaces Latham distributes.
findings.why_not_priced: Proxy with indirect transmission (Howdens is a manufacturer/depot model, partly price-led); nobody re-prices a $156k/day AIM distributor on it. Snippet-level sourcing via HL; RNS not read in full.

findings.finding: Finance income (GBP1.9m in H1 FY26, ~15% of PBT) will fall further as cash went from GBP59.8m (Sep 2025) to GBP51.2m (Mar 2026) on NDC capex, trimming PBT growth relative to operating profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 half-year flagged lower finance income and PBT down; stock still rose 4.39%.
findings.original_quote: Cash and cash equivalents of £51.2m (2025: £65.5m) remain strong, providing good cover for our future investments including the National Distribution Centre.
findings.why_not_priced: Mechanical and modellable by the house broker, so mostly in the bar; the residual is a headline-PBT optic in a name with retail holders.

findings.finding: The company itself said in August that supplier price increases (a revenue tailwind in H1) have levelled out and customers are 'slightly less confident', so the H2 current-trading paragraph, the release's one forward line, is more likely to be cautious than upbeat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2024 half-year with a cautious outlook -9.3%; Mar 2025 trading statement +11.6%; Jul 2026 prelims with 'momentum carried on' +8.3%: the outlook paragraph is what moves this name.
findings.original_quote: These price increases have now levelled out and we are not expecting any further rises... Our customers are slightly less confident in the economy compared to this time last year
findings.why_not_priced: Inference about tone, not a number; the stock has not moved since August (1,065p then, 1,057p now), so neither a downgrade nor an upgrade is in the price.

outside_window.finding: National Distribution Centre (Chatteris) construction completion targeted end-2026, fully operational end-2027; any cost or timing slip would be disclosed later than this window unless flagged in the interims

lessons_applied: A finding about a number already told to the market is worth ~0: the AGM pre-release finding cut from +0.5 to +0.2
Size abs_move on what is new and on thin turnover, not on the 1.22% median reaction: abs_move 4.5 -> 5.0
